q: (Only Allaah knows the correct meaning of this letter.)
By the oath of the Glorious Qur'aan
v.s: Qāf. By the honoured Qur’ān…
v.c: Qãf. By the glorious Quran!

q: (despite receiving proof that Rasulullaah ﷺ is a Rasool)
has come to them from among themselves
(warning them about the coming of Qiyaamah and resurrection).
v.s: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
v.c: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing!

q: “Will we be brought back to life after we have
(died, after we have been buried and)
become sand? This resurrection is certainly farfetched
v.s: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
v.c: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”

q: We know what the earth diminishes of them
(decomposes of their bodies and we are able to collect every part together for resurrection)
with Us is the Protected Book
(the “Lowhul Mahfoodh” which contains these and all other details).
v.s: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
v.c: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record.

q: reject the truth when it comes to them and are in a confused
v.s: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
v.c: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.

q: (To understand Our power to resurrect the dead,)
Have they not looked at the sky above
it and that it has no cracks
(despite its size, height, age and many functions)?
v.s: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
v.c: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless?

q: the earth which We have spread out, placed massive mountains on it and have produced on it every
v.s: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
v.c: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—

q: Eye-openers and reminders for every repentant slave
(sincere believer informing him that Our powers are immense and that resurrecting the dead is a small feat for Us).
v.s: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to God].
v.c: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺.

q: We have sent blessed rains from the sky and have grown with it gardens grains for harvest...
v.s: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
v.c: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest,

q: ...and tall date palms with interwoven branches...
v.s: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
v.c: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit,

q: ...as a provision for man. And We have
v.s: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
v.c: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺.

q: The nation of Nooh ﵊, the people of the well
(a community of Kuffaar who were swallowed by the earth as they sat beside a well)
v.s: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
v.c: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd,

q: So too did the Aad, Fir'oun, the people of Loot ﵊.
v.s: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
v.c: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot,

q: and the nation of Tubba. Each one of them rejected their Rusul, so My warning
v.s: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
v.c: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled.

q: Did We get tired with the first creation
(after creating everything for the first time)?
No. Yet they are in doubt
(resurrection, which would be easier because it is a repeat of an act that has already been performed previously).
v.s: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
v.c: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation.
v.h: Allah’s Power to Resurrect and Know All

q: We have created man, We are aware of the
and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
v.s: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
v.c: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein.

q: (record the good and bad acts of a person),
sitting on his right and left hand sides
v.s: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
v.c: As the two recording-angels— ˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺,

q: there is a guard ready by him.
(An angel immediately records the good or bad speech).
v.s: He [i.e., man] does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
v.c: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺.

q: of death will bring the truth
(of Imaan to every person). (Then it will then be said to the dying person,)
is what you used to avoid.”
v.s: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
v.c: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape!

q: (Then, to bring people back to life on the day of Qiyaamah,)
“This is what you were warned about.”
v.s: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
v.c: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of.

q: Every soul shall come with an angel
(who will take him to the place where he will be questioned)
(the angel who has recorded all his actions).
v.s: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
v.c: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify.

q: We have removed your veils from you
(you can now see what was unseen to you in the world).”
v.s: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
v.c: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”

q: (the angel who always remained with him to record his actions)
say, “This is what I have ready
v.s: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
v.c: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

q: (After reckoning, Allaah will command the angels saying,)
v.s: [God will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
v.c: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever,

v.s: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
v.c: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter,

q: who ascribed another Ilaah with Allaah. So fling
v.s: Who made [as equal] with God another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
v.c: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”

q: (the Shaytaan who always remained with him)
will say, “O our Rabb! I did not
mislead him but he was in distant deviation
(of his own accord. So do not punish me for his wrongdoing).'
v.s: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
v.c: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”

q: I have already sent a warning to you
(informing you that those who go astray shall be punished).”
v.s: [God] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
v.c: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning.

q: that proceeds from Me shall never be altered and I do not oppress My slaves.
(They will be punished only because they deserve the punishment for their sins).”
v.s: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
v.c: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”

q: We shall ask Jahannam, “Are you full?” and she will reply, “Are there any more
(to come because I still have more space)?”
v.s: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
v.c: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”

q: Jannah will be brought close to those with Taqwa and will not be far away
(so that it can be observed in all its splendour).
v.s: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
v.c: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.

q: “This is what you have been promised for every penitent
v.s: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to God] and keeper [of His covenant].
v.c: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—

q: “The one who feared Allaah without seeing Him and has arrived with a repentant heart
(a heart that is attached to Allaah).”
v.s: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
v.c: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺.

q: (Upon reaching Jannah, they will be told)
(without any fear of hardship or fear of being removed).
This is a day of eternal
v.s: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
v.c: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

q: They shall have whatever they desire there
and We even have something extra for them.
(They will see Allaah Himself and would have secured His everlasting pleasure.)
v.s: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
v.c: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more.

q: How many were the nations that We destroyed before them
(However, despite their strength and resources, they could not escape Allaah's punishment.)
v.s: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
v.c: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape?

q: in this for him who has a heart
v.s: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
v.c: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear.

q: We have created the heavens, the earth and whatever is between the two in six days without fatigue even remotely touching Us.
(How can resurrection then be difficult for Us?)
v.s: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
v.c: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue.

q: and glorify the praises of your Rabb before sunrise and before sunset
(by reading Tasbeeh or performing Nafl salaat).
v.s: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [God] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
v.c: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.

q: (by engaging in Tasbeeh and Nafl salaah)
during a portion of the night as well and after prostration
v.s: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
v.c: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers.

q: (to what has already been said and what is still to come). (Do not forget)
(because wherever one will be, the sound will seem nearby or from Baitul Muqaddas).
v.s: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
v.c: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place,

q: The day when people shall hear the screech
in truth, this is the day of resurrection
(after the second blowing of the trumpet).
v.s: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
v.c: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺.

q: Indeed it is only We who give life and death and to Us shall be the return
(of every soul and none will be able to escape).
v.s: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
v.c: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return.

q: The day when the earth shall split open from above them
This shall be a gathering very easy for Us.
v.s: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
v.c: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us.

q: are not one to force them
(to accept Imaan for you are not a tyrant).
Warn by means of this Qur'aan him who fears My warning
(because these are the ones who will take heed).
v.s: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
v.c: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning.
